slides.title: Say hello to the Mochi mascots
slides.body: Mochi now has a whole family of stickers that pop up where they help.
bullets: A different happy Mochi on every finished job, and a puzzled one when something went wrong
Each page has its own Mochi next to the title
Click any sticker and it squishes

slides.title: A cosier look
slides.body: The default theme is now warm strawberry-milk pink in light mode and cocoa in dark mode.
bullets: Rounder titles in the Fredoka font
A bigger Mochi logo in the sidebar and on the app icon
Boxes and chips that stay readable in every light theme

slides.title: A guide for new users
slides.body: The first time Mochi opens it now walks you through everything.
bullets: Open the tour again from the About page
After each update, pages like this one tell you what changed
